policy.dynamic_regions: must declare bounded span and stride

registers.technical_function: Programs the recovered HT20 channel code and completes the RFPLL start strobe.
registers.value_constraints: Channel 1 through 13; prefix 0x42844000, base 0x380, stride 0x280.
registers.side_effect: Advances RF configuration generation, records PLL completion, and decodes channel/bandwidth.
registers.failure_mode: Missing completion, unsupported channel, or unsupported bandwidth is a hard radio-legality error.
registers.provenance: Pinned public-API oracle trace and causal Renvo RF model.

registers.technical_function: First word of each recovered transmit-gain tuple.
registers.value_constraints: Exactly 43 ordered tuples from a pinned 8, 14, or 20 dBm table.
registers.side_effect: Starts or advances gain-table calibration assembly.
registers.failure_mode: Malformed ordering or tuple contents invalidates calibration.
registers.provenance: Pinned public-API oracle trace and causal Renvo RF model.

registers.technical_function: Second word of each recovered transmit-gain tuple.
registers.value_constraints: Must immediately follow the matching first word in each of 43 tuples.
registers.side_effect: Advances gain-table calibration assembly.
registers.failure_mode: Missing or out-of-order writes invalidate calibration.
registers.provenance: Pinned public-API oracle trace and causal Renvo RF model.

registers.technical_function: Completes each gain tuple and resolves the final transmit-power ceiling.
registers.value_constraints: Must complete all 43 table entries and resolve to 8, 14, or 20 dBm.
registers.side_effect: Marks calibration valid for the current RF and Wi-Fi reset generations.
registers.failure_mode: Partial, stale, or unsupported power state is a hard radio-legality error.
registers.provenance: Pinned public-API oracle trace and causal Renvo RF model.

registers.technical_function: Forces the Wi-Fi frontend off with value 0x0200 and releases it with zero.
registers.value_constraints: This driver writes only 0x0000 or 0x0200.
registers.side_effect: Controls whether configured RF state may receive or enter airtime.
registers.failure_mode: A forced-off or unknown frontend state rejects airtime.
registers.provenance: Pinned public-API oracle trace and causal Renvo RF model.

registers.technical_function: Programs station-interface MAC address bytes 0 through 3.
registers.value_constraints: Little-endian packing of the first four address bytes.
registers.side_effect: Contributes to receive-interface matching and crypto key selection.
registers.failure_mode: An absent or mismatched interface prevents addressed receive/crypto selection.
registers.provenance: Pinned oracle trace and native Wi-Fi MAC regression coverage.

registers.technical_function: Programs station-interface MAC bytes 4 and 5 plus the valid bit.
registers.value_constraints: Address bytes in bits 15:0 and valid bit 16 set.
registers.side_effect: Activates interface slot zero.
registers.failure_mode: A slot without the valid bit is excluded from address matching.
registers.provenance: Pinned oracle trace and native Wi-Fi MAC regression coverage.

registers.technical_function: Transfers ownership of the RX DMA descriptor base; zero disables RX DMA.
registers.value_constraints: Zero or a nonzero four-byte-aligned internal-memory descriptor address.
registers.side_effect: Arms or retires native receive DMA ownership.
registers.failure_mode: Invalid descriptor memory is rejected before packet delivery.
registers.provenance: Pinned oracle trace and native RX DMA tests.

registers.technical_function: Valid bitmap for the 32 native Wi-Fi key slots.
registers.value_constraints: The independent station sets only slot-zero bit after writing all ten words.
registers.side_effect: Makes the matching CCMP key visible to native transmit and receive selection.
registers.failure_mode: Missing, ambiguous, malformed, or unsupported selection is a hard crypto legality error.
registers.provenance: Pinned oracle trace plus native CCMP selection tests.

registers.technical_function: Enables Wi-Fi TX-done and RX-done MAC event delivery.
registers.value_constraints: Only event bits 7 and 14 are enabled by this driver.
registers.side_effect: Controls the masked native Wi-Fi interrupt condition.
registers.failure_mode: A missing mask produces polling timeout rather than fabricated completion.
registers.provenance: Pinned oracle trace and interrupt-source qualification.

registers.technical_function: Latched Wi-Fi MAC event state polled for TX and RX completion.
registers.value_constraints: This driver consumes TX-done bit 7 and RX-done bit 14.
registers.side_effect: None on read; state remains latched until the clear register is written.
registers.failure_mode: No event before the bounded loop produces a stable timeout or no-packet result.
registers.provenance: Pinned oracle trace and interrupt-source qualification.

registers.technical_function: Write-one-to-clear Wi-Fi MAC event bits.
registers.value_constraints: This driver clears only TX-done bit 7 and RX-done bit 14.
registers.side_effect: Clears the corresponding latched event and may deassert the interrupt.
registers.failure_mode: Uncleared state cannot be reused as proof of a later completion.
registers.provenance: Pinned oracle trace and exact interrupt replay.

registers.technical_function: Clears completed native transmit-queue ownership bits.
registers.value_constraints: All bits are cleared at init; queue-zero bit is cleared after each completion.
registers.side_effect: Releases queue zero for a later descriptor submission.
registers.failure_mode: Kicking an uncleared queue is a hard queue-ownership error.
registers.provenance: Pinned oracle trace and native queue lifecycle tests.

registers.technical_function: Completed native transmit-queue bitmap.
registers.value_constraints: This driver tests queue-zero bit only after TX-done is latched.
registers.side_effect: None on read.
registers.failure_mode: TX-done without matching queue completion does not complete the request.
registers.provenance: Pinned oracle trace and native queue lifecycle tests.

registers.technical_function: Submits one queue-zero TX DMA descriptor and transfers ownership to the MAC.
registers.value_constraints: Enable bits 31:30 equal three; descriptor uses a nonzero aligned low-20-bit address.
registers.side_effect: Creates one active TX operation and one eventual queue completion.
registers.failure_mode: Invalid DMA or duplicate ownership is a hard error; no response becomes a bounded timeout.
registers.provenance: Pinned oracle trace and native TX descriptor qualification.

registers.technical_function: Starts native Wi-Fi reset and reports synchronous ready acknowledgement.
registers.value_constraints: Write start bit 1, then require ready bit 0 on readback.
registers.side_effect: Zeroizes MAC DMA, queue, interrupt, and crypto state and advances the MAC reset generation without invalidating independently programmed RF calibration.
registers.failure_mode: Missing ready acknowledgement returns a stable initialization failure.
registers.provenance: Pinned oracle trace, genuine ESP-IDF initialization ordering, and reset-generation tests.

registers.technical_function: Ten-word native key-table slot containing peer match, control class, and key material.
registers.value_constraints: All ten words are written before slot-zero valid is set; control class is the supported pairwise CCMP encoding.
registers.side_effect: Supplies the exact peer/interface/key tuple used by hardware CCMP selection.
registers.failure_mode: Partial or unsupported slot contents are rejected when the valid bit is consumed.
registers.provenance: Causal Renvo crypto model, project-owned WPA2 driver, and exact CCMP qualification; not observed in the initialization oracle.

registers.technical_function: Preserves existing modem clocks while enabling Wi-Fi APB and MAC domains.
registers.value_constraints: Read-modify-write sets bits 9 and 10 only.
registers.side_effect: Makes native Wi-Fi register and airtime operations domain-ready.
registers.failure_mode: A disabled domain rejects RF airtime before any lower-priority RF diagnostic.
registers.provenance: Pinned oracle trace and modem-domain legality tests.

registers.technical_function: Routes the native Wi-Fi source to CPU interrupt line five.
registers.value_constraints: This driver writes CPU interrupt line 5.
registers.side_effect: Selects the interrupt-matrix destination for Wi-Fi events.
registers.failure_mode: Incorrect routing leaves completion visible only through polling.
registers.provenance: ESP32-C6 platform interrupt inventory and Renvo interrupt-matrix model.

registers.technical_function: Enables CPU interrupt line five without clearing other PLIC enables.
registers.value_constraints: Read-modify-write sets bit 5 only.
registers.side_effect: Allows the selected machine interrupt to become pending at the CPU.
registers.failure_mode: A disabled line cannot deliver native completion interrupts.
registers.provenance: RISC-V PLIC platform contract and Renvo PLIC model.

registers.technical_function: Programs priority three for CPU interrupt line five.
registers.value_constraints: This driver writes priority 3.
registers.side_effect: Places Wi-Fi completion above the configured PLIC threshold.
registers.failure_mode: Priority at or below threshold suppresses CPU delivery.
registers.provenance: RISC-V PLIC platform contract and Renvo PLIC model.

registers.technical_function: Sets the machine-context PLIC threshold to one.
registers.value_constraints: This driver writes threshold 1.
registers.side_effect: Permits priority-three Wi-Fi completion delivery.
registers.failure_mode: An excessive threshold suppresses CPU delivery.
registers.provenance: RISC-V PLIC platform contract and Renvo PLIC model.

registers.technical_function: UART0 byte FIFO used only for the deterministic command/checkpoint protocol.
registers.value_constraints: Low eight bits contain one byte.
registers.side_effect: Write emits one byte; read consumes one queued byte.
registers.failure_mode: An empty receive FIFO is detected through status before reading.
registers.provenance: ESP32-C6 UART platform model and exact UART replay.

registers.technical_function: Reports UART0 RX FIFO occupancy for nonblocking input.
registers.value_constraints: This driver consumes the low ten-bit RX FIFO count only.
registers.side_effect: None on read.
registers.failure_mode: Zero count returns no input without touching the FIFO.
registers.provenance: ESP32-C6 UART platform model and exact UART replay.
